user.title: Notify Subscriptions
user.description: Every user picks which notifications they get and on which of their devices.

send.name: Send
send.description: Sends a notification to everyone subscribed to the topic, on the channels they picked.

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra data passed to the notify services (merged over the topic data).

set_subscription.name: Set subscription
set_subscription.description: Changes the subscription of the user who calls the action.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: off, all your devices, picked devices, or toggle one channel.

test.name: Send test
test.description: Sends a test notification of the topic to the caller's subscribed channels only.

id.name: Id
id.description: Lowercase latin letters, digits and _. Never change it after automations use it.

default_mode.name: Default for new users
default_mode.description: What users who never changed the topic get.

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra data sent with every notification of the topic (e.g. push sound).

remove_topic.name: Remove topic
remove_topic.description: Admin only. Also removes all subscriptions to it.

set_channel.name: Add or update channel
set_channel.description: Admin only. Binds a notify service or entity (Telegram, e-mail, …) to a user.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: Home Assistant user who owns the channel.

import_legacy.name: Import legacy subscriptions
import_legacy.description: Admin only. Reads u:USER_ID / d:DEVICE_TRACKER tokens from an input_text and stores them as subscriptions to the topic.
